draft.subject: Embedded Software Engineer I role at ASI
draft.body:
Justin Mascarenhas here, I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. I saw the Embedded Software Engineer I opening at ASI and wanted to reach out directly.

My background is a solid match for what the posting asks for. I have hands on experience writing embedded C and C++ for real time systems, including bare metal firmware on STM32 running FreeRTOS, and I have worked with UART, I2C and SPI protocols across several robotics projects. I also bring ROS2 experience and general software engineering practices like unit testing and version control.

I would appreciate you taking a look at my resume for this role and letting me know if you think it could be a good fit.
